AdorneeBoundingBox.luau.description: This utility class can observe the bounding box (size + position) of any Roblox instance effectively. It handles anchored + unanchored instances, and tries to do it in a performance friendly way. Public entry points include `AdorneeBoundingBox.new`, `AdorneeBoundingBox.SetAdornee`, `AdorneeBoundingBox.ObserveBoundingBox`, `AdorneeBoundingBox.GetBoundingBox`, `AdorneeBoundingBox.ObserveCFrame`,…

AdorneeModelBoundingBox.luau.description: Adornee Model Bounding Box provides the class/model implementation used by the Adorneeboundingbox package. Public entry points include `AdorneeModelBoundingBox.new`, `AdorneeModelBoundingBox.ObserveCFrame`, `AdorneeModelBoundingBox.ObserveSize`.

AdorneePartBoundingBox.luau.description: Adornee Part Bounding Box provides the class/model implementation used by the Adorneeboundingbox package. Public entry points include `AdorneePartBoundingBox.new`, `AdorneePartBoundingBox.ObserveCFrame`, `AdorneePartBoundingBox.ObserveSize`.
